gaps.explanation: p6 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds: detail[] has the operating revenues of the three fund columns (Sanitation 29,301 + Water 305,492 + Sewer 59,660 = 394,453 = printed Total operating revenues). The NONOPERATING REVENUES are printed only in the Total column: Grant income 6,071,405 and Interest income 43 (Total nonoperating revenues 6,071,448 = gap). The Statement of Activities p2 assigns the grant to Water (Capital Grants and Contributions 6,071,405 on the Water row) and the interest to the Business-Type Activities column only (Investment earnings 43). Check: 394,453 + 6,071,405 + 43 = 6,465,901 = statement total.
